name: metr_point_v0_wsp_candidate_v1
rationale: Direct weight-space repair for METR-LA point-missing version_0. Halve the GCN weights attached to the two unregistered random-graph powers. In the final MLP, suppress the spurious negative GELU tail of neuron 202 by scaling its affine input by 4 and its effective output coefficient by 1/4. Broaden the useful positive correction from the negative tail of neuron 9 by scaling its affine input by 0.75 and its effective output coefficient by 1/0.75. Both gate edits preserve the zero threshold and positive linear asymptote. All choices derive from checkpoint inspection and calibration forward passes. A stronger neuron-9 widening (0.5) regressed, so it was rejected. This recipe is frozen before independent confirmation of this final variant and before any test evaluation.
